title: 2025: one temporal field unifies bioelectric morphogenesis and microtubule coherence

statements.text: Bioelectric morphogenesis and quantum coherent microtubular states arise from one conserved temporal transport field, giving coherence times and bioelectric relaxation rates as functions of temporal shear and spacetime curvature.

standing.reason: The author graded this claim superseded in his July 2026 Version 2.0 rebuild. No test has decided it.

sources.quote: A four-dimensional temporal hydrodynamic formulation is developed in which bioelectric morphogenesis and quantum coherent microtubular states arise from a single conserved temporal transport field.
